why_no_canonical_rows: The screening-log schema requires a fiscal_period label, and the ticker+fiscal_period pair is its duplicate key. No official source in this sweep supplied a fiscal-period label for any pending candidate, so a canonical row could only be written by inventing one. The protocol forbids that, and weakening the schema to fit an observation is exactly what it forbids. Every item therefore stays in this manifest.
